scopeChangeReason: Scope is the union of the five checklist items' declared file write-sets. The two create paths are the ported dossier client and the new smoke task. assets/ and both dist/ directories are gitignored build output regenerated by the allowed build commands, so they are excluded from the hand-edited surface rather than treated as source.

acknowledgements.reason: Not scope creep: this story's own in-scope change revoked a security pin, and re-approving it is work this story created and must close. That guard stores an exact content fingerprint of packages/main/src/handlers/graph.ts on a dynamic-code-loading allowlist; its own comment states ANY edit to the handler revokes the approval until a human re-approves it. CHK-003 necessarily edited that handler to add --story, so the fingerprint moved and the guard failed, blocking REVIEW->TEST. Before re-pinning, the security question the pin exists to ask was answered: the DYNAMIC-CODE SURFACE IS UNCHANGED. A normalized diff of every await import(...), createRequire(...), eval( and new Function( occurrence in the handler against main reports no difference; the five approved loader call sites are byte-identical and only their line numbers shifted. The --story change adds string validation and URL construction only, introduces no new dynamic-code capability, and does not widen the --root-influenceable argument path this approval already accepts. The human re-approval the pin demands was obtained explicitly from the user before the fingerprint was touched, and the re-approval rationale is recorded in comments at both pin sites.
